name: mech-32-chaser-room
source: mech-32-chaser Test Level: open room with one dead end at the warp corner; the chaser copies each player move, so running straight for the orb drives it against the far wall where it stays while the player closes in and is caught; dropping to the lower lane first leads its copied steps along the open row so its upward copy is held by the top wall while the player crosses to the orb and warp
